useCases.title: Donate an idle key, earn credits back
useCases.summary: Share an idle provider key, earn credits
useCases.problem: Free-tier and flat-rate keys sit unused at the end of the month. That headroom evaporates unless someone else can use it.

command.text: Dashboard → BYOK → open the key → Donate to the shared pool

snippets.code: Dashboard → BYOK → open the key → Donate to the shared pool
snippets.title: Where to click

steps: Turn on donate for that key. Confirm your provider's terms allow sharing it.
Pending credits accrue from pool traffic. A donated key can also unlock Go so you can call anyrouter/free.
